_about: Crawler decisions, reviewed one by one on 2026-11-12 (AI Crawl Control list) and from the first weekly check (visitors outside that list). Keys are user-agent tokens, matched case-insensitively as substrings — the same names public/robots.txt uses. Enforcement lives in Cloudflare (AI Crawl Control → Security) and robots.txt; this file is what scripts/check-ai-crawlers.mjs compares visitors against. 'ignore' = not part of the AI policy (SEO, monitoring, link previews). 'verifiedByCloudflare' = allowed crawlers Cloudflare verifies by origin (cf.client.bot); they are deliberately NOT exceptions in the 'Block unverified bots' rule, so a fake Googlebot is still blocked.

allow.Googlebot: Google Search. Gemini training opted out via Google-Extended in robots.txt
allow.bingbot: Bing, and through it DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Yahoo, Qwant
allow.Applebot: Siri, Spotlight, Safari. Apple AI training opted out via Applebot-Extended
allow.archive.org_bot: Wayback Machine; doubles as independent proof of publication date
allow.Arquivo-web-crawler: Portuguese national web archive; owner's call, allowed
allow.Bravebot: Brave Search — independent index; also feeds AI answers, same trade-off as Bing
allow.facebookexternalhit: link previews on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp — must never be blocked

block.CCBot: Common Crawl — the largest open AI training corpus
block.Bytespider: ByteDance training; known to ignore robots.txt
block.Amazonbot: Amazon; may train Amazon AI models
block.Timpibot: decentralised search; sells index as AI data
block.PetalBot: Huawei Petal Search; no AI opt-out
block.Baiduspider: Baidu; feeds ERNIE, no AI opt-out
block.Anchor Browser: cloud browser for AI agents and scraping
block.CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler: crawls for other Cloudflare customers' AI
block.ExaSearchBot: Exa — search API built for AI
block.ImageMetaBot: image classification — harvests photo content and metadata
